construction-hint: Right-click with materials in hand to assemble (see block hints)
construction-blueprint-hint: Blueprint: right-click with required materials in hand to fill the ghost
construction-handbook-assembly-hint: Blueprints are not crafted. Place a blue ghost with the schematic book, then right-click the ghost while holding materials. Breaking the machine returns only the spent materials.
item-handbooktext-econstructionbook: Right-click in the air to choose a machine schematic. Aim at a block and right-click to place its blueprint. Sneak + right-click places against the targeted block (e.g. thermoelectric plates on the generator). Assemble the ghost by right-clicking it with the required materials.
construction-book-hint: Right-click in the air to choose a schematic, then right-click a block to place it.
